Module 1 steer sweep.material: SDS MK4i turret: billet wheel, nitrile tread, aluminium mounts (supplier)
Module 1 steer sweep.purpose: Occupies the module 1 wheel and turret through any steering angle and puts the tread on the floor at Z = 0.
Module 1 steer sweep.rationale: Four-module swerve is the project drivetrain; the full 360 deg steer sweep must stay clear of the frame, bumpers, leads and battery while the robot re-azimuths during the loaded carry.

Module 1 housing.rationale: The SDS MK4i L2 corner is the selected purchased module; its motors sit inboard and govern the lead and crossmember space under the equipment sheet.

Upper support.material: 6061-T6 tube (r3 stringer extensions and inlet truss)
Upper support.purpose: Extends the upper pan stringers rearward and lands the inlet truss on the perimeter.
Upper support.rationale: The fixed inlet sits behind the pan pivot and above the battery path, so it needs its own stringer extensions and truss legs reaching the frame.

Upper support part 2.material: 6061-T6 tube (r3 stringer extensions and inlet truss)
Upper support part 2.purpose: Extends the upper pan stringers rearward and lands the inlet truss on the perimeter.
Upper support part 2.rationale: The fixed inlet sits behind the pan pivot and above the battery path, so it needs its own stringer extensions and truss legs reaching the frame.

Pan cassette.material: 6061-T6 cradles and plates, REV bearings, UltraPlanetary and NEO 550 (r3)
Pan cassette.purpose: Carries the pan bearings, drive gearbox and NEO 550, both stops, the closing spring and the inhibit cam and switch, and lifts out as one unit for service.
Pan cassette.rationale: The guarded pan needs a removable support on the X110 and X250 cradles so its drive, stops and journals can be serviced without disturbing the chassis.

Guarded pan.purpose: Receives the station pipe at 70 deg stow, carries it and tips 72 deg to release it into the L1 trough.
Guarded pan.rationale: The matched fixed-path comparison lost an adverse pipe in every variant, so the role relies on a powered rotating pan with positive stops (pan-selection premise).

Inlet chute crossmember 1.purpose: Supports the feed panels at their joint.
Inlet chute crossmember 1.rationale: The chute panels are thin sheet and need a cross support under the rolling pipe at the panel break.

Inlet chute crossmember 2.purpose: Supports the feed panels at their joint.
Inlet chute crossmember 2.rationale: The chute panels are thin sheet and need a cross support under the rolling pipe at the panel break.

Inlet guides and frame.purpose: Guides the station pipe laterally and supports the chute from the stringer extensions.
Inlet guides and frame.rationale: The pipe arrives at about 2.5 m/s from the station chute; side guides keep its 301.6 mm length square to the pan opening.

Inlet guides and frame part 2.purpose: Guides the station pipe laterally and supports the chute from the stringer extensions.
Inlet guides and frame part 2.rationale: The pipe arrives at about 2.5 m/s from the station chute; side guides keep its 301.6 mm length square to the pan opening.

Inlet chute panels.purpose: Forms the rolling surface that brings the station pipe down into the stowed pan.
Inlet chute panels.rationale: A passive chute lets the pan stay at stow during receive, so the receive needs no extra actuator.

Bumper ring.material: 4 mm backer, 69.5 mm PE foam, 0.5 mm cover (project rear-facet record)
Bumper ring.purpose: Protects the frame perimeter in contact with field elements and robots.
Bumper ring.rationale: Bumpers are required on the frame perimeter; the ring follows the actual frame plan hull so its backing clears the lower cassette corners.

Power distribution hub.purpose: Distributes battery power to the nine motor controllers and the control system through branch breakers.
Power distribution hub.rationale: Every motor and controller load in the voltage budget draws through it.

roboRIO 2.purpose: Runs the robot program, the pan limits and the drive control.
roboRIO 2.rationale: A control computer is required to operate the robot.

VH-109 radio.purpose: Links the robot to the driver station and field.

Main 120 A breaker.purpose: Disconnects and protects the main battery circuit.
Main 120 A breaker.rationale: Required main disconnect; its reset button needs the hand path checked in service-breaker-reset.

Chassis battery plug and bracket.purpose: Mates the battery SB50 to the robot-side main leads.
Chassis battery plug and bracket.rationale: The battery must disconnect at a plug the plug-grip hand can reach.

Main power loom.purpose: Reserves the main lead route from the SB50 to the breaker and PDH.
Main power loom.rationale: The main leads must avoid the battery lift, the plug grip and the inlet truss legs.

Branch and CAN trunk.purpose: Reserves the branch power and CAN route from the PDH to the controllers.
Branch and CAN trunk.rationale: Branch and CAN wiring must cross the centre gap between the equipment sheets above the pan crossmembers.

Module 1 lead reserve.purpose: Reserves the module 1 motor and CANcoder leads between the module top and the equipment sheet.
Module 1 lead reserve.rationale: Module leads must leave the housing under the sheet without entering the steer sweep or the crossmembers.

Module 2 lead reserve.purpose: Reserves the module 2 motor and CANcoder leads between the module top and the equipment sheet.
Module 2 lead reserve.rationale: Module leads must leave the housing under the sheet without entering the steer sweep or the crossmembers.

Module 4 lead reserve.purpose: Reserves the module 4 motor and CANcoder leads between the module top and the equipment sheet.
Module 4 lead reserve.rationale: Module leads must leave the housing under the sheet without entering the steer sweep or the crossmembers.

Battery tray and retention.purpose: Supports and retains the battery case below the sills.
Battery tray and retention.rationale: The battery sits low and central for CG and must be retained against strikes yet lift out through the centre gap.

Dressed battery.material: Sealed lead-acid FRC battery with leads (excluded by R103)
Dressed battery.purpose: Supplies the robot; its case, leads and battery-side SB50 move together in service.
Dressed battery.rationale: The pack is the voltage source of the budget and its lift and rearward carry set the service path.

Breaker reset hand.purpose: Clearance gauge for a hand reaching the main breaker reset from above.
Breaker reset hand.rationale: Resetting the breaker between matches must not require removing the stringer extension or the inlet.

Plug grip hand.purpose: Clearance gauge for a hand gripping the SB50 pair to disconnect the battery.
Plug grip hand.rationale: The battery swap begins with this disconnect; the gauge keeps the space above the plugs free of leads.

CORAL pipe.purpose: The finite game piece followed from the station chute through the seat, tip and release.
CORAL pipe.rationale: The role scores two station pipes in the L1 trough; every receive, carry and release clearance is checked against the actual pipe length and diameter.

narrativeReview.read: Read end to end on 2026-11-21: the opening LEAVE, two TELEOP station-to-L1 cycles in sectors A and B, custody, trough release and support, park, the endgame choice and the empty-start fallback. commissioning.md restates the two-pipe objective for iteration 002.

objectives.objective: AUTO: leave the starting line with the whole occupied robot (3 points)
objectives.basis: A field-route objective for the empty robot; this package reserves the stowed starting configuration (940.5 mm tall, perimeter 2919.8 mm) but has no field fixture. Replay the opening-line study with the 17.25 mm rear cutback in the field rehearsal.

objectives.objective: TELEOP: take one station-issued CORAL from the red station (front approach)
objectives.basis: Cases receive-chute, receive-over-edge and receive-seat; premises station-receive-face, station-receive-time and station-arrival-speed.

objectives.objective: Carry it to the red reef while crossing peer routes
objectives.basis: Case loaded-carry (seated pipe in the pan hold band; steer covered by the static revolved envelopes); weak-pack voltage premise; peer traffic is field-side.

objectives.objective: Sustain a deliverable load: keep custody when accelerating, braking or contacted, and detect displacement or loss
objectives.basis: retention-review.json: no positive restraint on the open face at stow; powered events lift the pipe 24-114 ms (study-06); unpowered holding loses it at 3 g opening contact (study-05). No seated-pipe sensor or camera view is placed in this layout.

objectives.objective: Release into the intended L1 trough sector A, clear the wall and leave the pipe supported after withdrawal
objectives.basis: Cases tip-to-dump, release and reset-to-stow carry the pipe out past the pan edge, and the dock-support-margin premise holds the replay support; the reef wall and trough fixture are not placed, so whole-robot wall clearance at the 12 mm stand-off is not checked in this package.

objectives.objective: Return for a second station CORAL and score it in sector B with the first pipe as an obstacle
objectives.basis: The same ordered cycle repeats from reset-to-stow; sector B timing and the first-pipe obstacle are covered by the twelve-case replays behind the premises.

objectives.objective: PARK: reserve the south lane, stow, reach the zone and stop
objectives.basis: Case park (withdraw 300 mm from the scored pipe, pan stowed); the lane reservation is field-side.

objectives.objective: Endgame alternatives: shallow or deep CAGE
objectives.basis: The selected role parks; the occupied receiver has no demonstrated climb route (selected-role.md).
The stowed starting configuration and the park case are the same robot with no pipe aboard.

objectives.objective: Partner and station dependence: Red 1 station change and station depletion
objectives.basis: An alliance-chain and field-supply comparison owned by conceptual design; it changes no package volume.
